videos.t: Creation Vlog 2: It's a Prop Jetpack!
videos.desc: A prop jetpack designed to manufacture and sell online. This design will eventually be a physical prototype.
Jetpack shell design is finished, folks. Now I just do a lot of 3d printing and start deigning how to fit a fog machine inside.

The body of the jetpack is starting to take shape and the jets are now firing. (During one video you can see that the rates of flow coming out of the two jets are not equal to one another, but I will adjust that as things become more finalized)
We're getting close now folks. This week: sound

videos.t: Mandalorian Jetpack and Opensauce Maker Event
videos.desc:
This is a project summary of my latest build, a jetpack from the show The Mandalorian, complete with faux flame and smoke. I had the opportunity to showcase my work at William Osman's first year of putting on the event Opensauce. 

Reference model, by Slusho, that I used for designing my own model of the jetpack: 
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3568860

I am far from being done with this prop jetpack, but I believe that this will mark the end of the process for my first prototype. Check out some of my other builds on my channel!

Big thanks to everyone that helped make Opensauce happen, as

videos.desc: This time around I will be building a massive gargoyle costume, and I have just 8 weeks to do it!

videos.desc: There have certainly been some hardships to work through recently with 3D printing, but the mask design is coming along nicely!
With the wings able to open and close now, I just need to use some fabric to cover them. Hopefully the mask won't be far behind!

Welcome to my annual Halloween build review! This year I did a huge Pennywise costume, modeled after the most recent IT movies. I also incorporated environmental lighting and sound into my build, for the first time.

Special thanks to Arduino for sending me some of their new boards (Uno R4 Wi-Fi and Giga R1) to use on this project

GIGA: https://store.arduino.cc/pages/giga-r1-wifi

videos.t: Sinners Remmick Cosplay – Full Prosthetic Makeup & Costume Process
videos.desc:
Full process of building a completely prosthetic Remmick costume from Ryan Coogler’s Sinners (2025). 
This build uses cast-silicone prosthetics, theatrical makeup, 3D-printed parts, and a custom-built, miniature fog machine hidden inside a banjo.

0:17 Intro
0:39 Design
1:10 Silicone Casting
6:40 Silicone Painting
8:53 Banjo Fog Machine Build
9:43 Electronic Components and Arduino
10:44 Final Showcase
12:51 Outro

If you enjoyed the build, a like and subscribe really helps the channel!
